svg.title: ech-context: the session-size hint and the compact guard
svg.desc: On every prompt, session-size reads the newest main-thread token usage from the transcript tail; at or above 200k tokens it adds an information-only hint for Claude and shows you the size, at most once per 50k of growth. Before an automatic compaction, compact-guard tells the summary what to keep verbatim under a MUST SURVIVE heading. When the session resumes within 30 minutes of that automatic compaction, compact-guard adds a recovery line once. Both hooks can be switched off and fail open.

g.text: see the size line in the app
each hook times out at 10 s
at or above 200k tokens: a hint
within 30 min of an auto compaction:
at or above 200k, once per 50k of growth
the summary is told what to keep verbatim
within 30 min of the auto compaction

svg.text: Off: SESSION_SIZE=off, COMPACT_GUARD=off, or a session-size.off / compact-guard.off file in the data directory.
Both fail open: a crash exits 0 and prints nothing. A prompt is never refused; subagent prompts are skipped.
A subagent compaction gets its own keep list. Ledgers: session-size.jsonl and compact.jsonl in the data directory.
